A curated starting point

Source directory · compatibility not yet tested by this site. PhotoCraft documents layered PSD support, but that is not a guarantee that every Photoshop template, font or smart-object effect will survive editing and saving.

This page links to original resource providers. We do not currently host a tested PhotoCraft template pack. Treat every external PSD as a candidate until you complete the checks below.

Choose a first template

  • Social graphics: a photo, editable headline and a small number of shape layers make a manageable first test.
  • Product banners: choose layouts with separate product, background and text layers.
  • Business graphics: check required fonts, output dimensions and whether the intended print workflow is supported.
  • Packaging and apparel mockups: expect more testing when replacement depends on smart objects, warps or complex effects.

These are suggested use cases, not claims that specific packs have passed compatibility testing.

Check before committing to a template

  1. Read the author’s license and list of fonts. Keep the original archive unchanged.
  2. Open a copy of the PSD and compare it with the author’s preview.
  3. Edit one text layer and one image placeholder. Check masks, clipping and effects.
  4. Save under a new filename, close it and reopen it.
  5. Export a PNG or JPEG and compare dimensions, typography and color outside the editor.
  6. Record the PhotoCraft version, operating system, template source and any differences.

Only call a resource “tested” when that exact file has passed a documented workflow. Resource Boy restricts repackaging its resources for distribution; use original download links.
